verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a package manager could ship a frozen-lockfile mode. However, nothing in the pack documents a mode that fails the install when package.json and the lockfile disagree. The only nearby items are a community complaint that `npm ci` is slow (which never describes its behavior) and a doc line about switching registries with an existing lock file. Neither shows the enforcement this story asks for.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can enforce a frozen/immutable lockfile mode that fails the install when the manifest and lockfile disagree
